scope: Original English 2023 Uprising v23-10-12; complete standard 2–4-player multiplayer including standard scoring two-player Rival, optional base-box CHOAM with 20 standard contracts; relevant general/Uprising January 13 2025 FAQ. Other products, solo, optional Rival variants and six-player play excluded.

findings.title: CHOAM exhaustion fallback omits no-offer state while reserved Sardaukar contracts remain
findings.description: The 2-Solari fallback is stated for when all contracts have been taken by players. With Shaddam selected, all 18 generally available contracts can be gone while one or both reserved Sardaukar contracts remain set aside. Other humans cannot take those reserved contracts, so no face-up contract is available to them even though not all 20 contracts have been taken. The summary does not state their applicable fallback and its purported state table omits this legal state.

source_references.detail: Contract icon: take a face-up contract, or if there are none left gain 2 Solari.
Sardaukar Commander: set aside both Sardaukar contracts; only Shaddam can acquire them.
Shaddam may choose a reserved contract instead of a generally available contract and does not start in possession.

findings.recommended_correction: Key the fallback to no face-up contract being available to the acquiring player, while retaining Shaddam’s printed ability to choose a reserved Sardaukar contract. Explicitly cover exhausted general offers with reserved Sardaukar contracts still set aside.
